ref: ADR-0025 Families and the amendment of 2026-11-03 (text is code points; Q10: a malformed number is err:FORG0001 at the box); ADR-0026 (a function with a deviation has no assumed case)
note: ADR-0025 "Families" and the amendment of 2026-11-03: text counts, indexes and orders in code points, not UTF-16 units; a character outside the BMP is a catalogue deviation. One character outside the BMP counts 1 (UTF-16 would give 2), a, a clef and b count 3 (UTF-16: 4).
